commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+5' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) brings an opponent down and Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. Dortmund are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+4' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90+4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Yan Couto (Dortmund).
90+3' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.
90+2' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Joshua Kimmich and he is replaced by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) will replace Michael Olise.
90+1' Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+1' Yan Couto (Dortmund) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+1' Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Dortmund.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Konrad Laimer did his best and is replaced by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich).
89' Good movement by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
87' 2 - 3 What a hit! Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top left corner. 2:3.
87' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
86' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
86' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Luis Diaz with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
85' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
84' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Michael Olise. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.

83' 2 - 2 Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:2.
81' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
81' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
81' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) picks out Daniel Svensson with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
78' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
76' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
75' The substitution is prepared. Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Felix Nmecha.
75' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) replaces Maximilian Beier.
75' A substitution has been made. Karim Adeyemi is replaced by Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
74' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' 6:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 1:5.
70' 1 - 2 Goal! Gregor Kobel gets a hand on the penalty from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
70' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

69' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayern Munich are awarded a penalty.
68' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabio Silva walks off the pitch to be replaced by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund).
66' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
65' Karim Adeyemi plays the ball through to Yan Couto (Dortmund) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post.
63' Flag up against Fabio Silva (Dortmund). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Serge Gnabry cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
60' A lofted cross from Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
59' The cross into the penalty area from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
57' A mistake by a defender gifts Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the right post.
56' A sweet pass inside the box gives Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
55' Felix Nmecha does a good job setting up Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
54' 1 - 1 GOAL! Serge Gnabry meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
52' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dayot Upamecano.
51' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

51' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Wow, what an escape. Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
48' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
47' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.

46' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Sven Jablonski has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gregor Kobel reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+7' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45+5' Niko Kovac is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Emre Can (Dortmund) suffers an injury and Ramy Bensebaini comes on.
45+4' Emre Can (Dortmund) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
45+4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+2' A pass from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Gregor Kobel and the move breaks down.
45+1' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Flag goes up against Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

45' A neat pass finds Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel denies him with a good save.
44' Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
43' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Maximilian Beier.
42' Emre Can (Dortmund) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Emre Can (Dortmund) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
39' Emre Can (Dortmund) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) tries to find Konrad Laimer, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
37' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Yan Couto (Dortmund) works the corner short.
34' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
34' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
33' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
32' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) plays a terrific long ball forward to Konrad Laimer, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
31' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) sees the run of Yan Couto and tries to slip the ball to him, but Jonas Urbig sees the danger and gathers.
30' The ball is cleared after Fabio Silva (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
28' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:5. 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.

26' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Daniel Svensson flights the free kick into the box, where Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
25' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul. Dortmund will take a free kick near the side line.

24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
24' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
23' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Luis Diaz, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
22' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.

21' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
20' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
18' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
17' Ball possession – 26:74.
16' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Gregor Kobel easily deals with the threat.
15' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
14' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
13' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Emre Can (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
9' The foul by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was seen by Sven Jablonski who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Fabio Silva (Dortmund), but the defence gets it clear.
6' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
4' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.

2' A through ball from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fails to reach Serge Gnabry as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Serge Gnabry could have got into a promising position.
2' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) passes the ball onto Serge Gnabry, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will officiate today.
